'''Matacorn''' was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|world]]<ref name="EGTW" /> located in the [[Matacorn system/Legends|Matacorn system]], a part of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Lambda sector/Legends|Lambda sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> A nondescript [[Merchant/Legends|trade]] world, it was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Hurst Romodi/Legends|Hurst Romodi]].<ref name="EGTW" /> Matacorn also shared its name with the [[Matacorn campaign]], a part of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="HR">{{WEGCite|story="Irrefutable Logic"|book=Heroes & Rogues}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Matacorn was introduced via mention of the Matacorn campaign in "[["Irrefutable Logic"|Irrefutable Logic]]," a short companion narrative included in ''[[Heroes & Rogues]]'', a [[1995]] sourcebook written by [[Paul Sudlow]] and [[Rick D. Stuart|Rick Stuart]] for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="HR" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Matacorn [[Star system/Legends|system]] in grid square P-15,<ref name="TEA" /> and in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]], Matacorn was finally established as a distinct world.<ref name="EGTW" />
